name: Epilepsy-iEEG-Interictal-Multicenter-Dataset

cohort.types: drug-resistant focal epilepsy; some treated with RNS ('rns' prefix)
cohort.sites: participants list NIH, KUMC, Miami, JHU, UMF, JHH; 39 subjects have data folders

modalities: Interictal iEEG, 54 runs (5.8 h), tasks interictal / interictal-awake / interictal-asleep; median 128 channels; 500–2000 Hz
format: BIDS 1.6 EDF + .mat; derivatives: HFO detection, source–sink
labels: Per-channel soz / rz / epz columns: SOZ for all 39 subjects with data, resected zone for 23, EPZ for 20
caveats: participants.tsv lists 52 people but only 39 have data folders
checks: Cloned git tree; counted soz/rz/epz 'yes' per subject from 54 channels.tsv files.
pipeline: The cleanest open interictal SOZ labels (per channel, in the BIDS files). Good for an interictal onset agent and for the Bernabei 2023 train/val/test split.
key_claim: Interictal iEEG with channel-level SOZ labels for 39 patients; no coordinates.

evidence.quote: Some subjects, namely with the ``rns`` prefix in their subject ID were treated with RNS rather then surgical resection/ablation.
sharing a centralized high-quality, well-annotated, multicentre dataset consisting of >100 patients
